title: 第15章 妖魔怪谈第16章 新女老师唐月
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: 送叶心夏回到姑姑家，陪她们吃了一个晚饭之后，莫凡刚打算继续练习一下雷系魔法，可是，当自己按照平常的方式去练习把控的时候，却立刻感觉到头疼欲裂，那种感觉就好像是在网吧连续打了三个通宵的英雄联盟，整个人都要挂掉了！
尼玛什么情况？？？
精神虚弱的赶脚。
难道是因为今天我使用了两次雷印，雷系魔能的过度消耗导致我精神极度疲乏？
有没搞错，算上公交车那次不完全释放的话，我今天也不过是也只使用了两次雷印，蓝tm就空了？
本以为自己花了有五个月的冥修，使得自己的星尘内的魔能已经足够庞大了，谁知道仅仅释放两次雷印，整个雷系星尘感觉都黯淡下去了。
雷系星尘往常在精神世界里都是比较绚丽多姿的，那紫色的光辉在七颗星子的呼应下宛如一幅唯美的星空画卷，可这会，整个星尘都失去了光泽，陷入到了一片晦暗之中。
一开始莫凡吓了一跳，好在随着自己放松下来休息，雷系星尘有慢慢恢复光辉的迹象，尽管非常缓慢！
“看来，星尘还不够璀璨，每施展一次魔法，星尘的光辉就会黯淡，完全黯淡下去就表示着星尘内的能量消耗干净了。”
星尘库存着魔法之能。
难怪班主任薛木生一天到晚都在强调：哪怕在枯燥也要保持冥修，一个天资再高的魔法师若不勤奋冥修，也会变得无比平庸。
这句话基本上可以理解为：你技能再叼又怎么样，没蓝还是个渣渣！
算了，不想这些东西，赶紧睡上一觉，不然真要挂了！
窝在房间里，一觉睡到大天亮。
叶心夏这姑娘也是乖巧，都快中午了也没舍得叫自己起床。
莫凡从床铺上爬了起来，整个人精神抖索。
娴熟的进入冥修状态，查看了一下自己的星尘，发现星尘已经明亮了大半，想必很快就能够完全恢复往常的光辉了。
“对了，我的雷系恐怕不太好暴露在外人面前，虽然这是‘法’治社会，保不齐会遭人嫉妒，比如说在博城能够只手遮天的穆氏世家。看来我还是得把火系给修炼起来，这样比较容易掩人耳目。”莫凡一边刷着牙一边思考这个问题。
只是，一天自己的精力就那么多，怎么才可以即让雷系正房吃饱，又把火系妃子弄得服服帖帖的呢？
莫凡能够在五个月时间把雷系技能给修出来，正是因为他把所有的修炼时间都放在了雷系身上，甭管火系小妖精有多迷人、魅力四射，莫凡都是专情专一。
每年的魔法考核大概也还有半年时间，自己不想这么早暴露雷系力量的话，就得全神贯注的在下学期全部修火系，把火系技能初阶技能也修炼出来。
可这样做，就意味着自己的雷系星尘的成长要停滞半年了。
不去冥修，星尘不会凭白无故变的更加强壮的！
莫凡对自己接下去的冥修时间进行了一些小规划。
content_en:
…
After sending Ye Xinxia back to his aunt's house and having dinner with them, Mo Fan just planned to continue practicing thunder magic. However, when he practiced the control in the usual way, he immediately felt a splitting headache. It felt like he had played League of Legends for three consecutive nights in an Internet cafe and was about to die!
What's going on, Nima? ? ?
Mentally weak and rushing.
Is it because I used Thunder Seal twice today and the excessive consumption of thunder magic energy caused me to be extremely mentally exhausted?
Is there any mistake? Counting the incomplete release on the bus, I only used Thunder Seal twice today, so the blue tm was empty?
I thought that after five months of meditative cultivation, the magic energy in my star dust was already huge enough, but who knew that after only releasing the thunder seal twice, the entire thunder star dust felt dim.
Thunder star dust is usually more colorful in the spiritual world. The purple brilliance echoed by the seven stars is like a beautiful picture of the starry sky. But this time, the entire star dust has lost its luster and fell into darkness.
Mo Fan was shocked at first, but fortunately as he relaxed and rested, the thunder star dust showed signs of slowly returning to its glory, albeit very slowly!
"It seems that the stardust is not bright enough. Every time the magic is cast, the stardust's brilliance will dim. If it dims completely, it means that the energy in the stardust has been completely consumed."
Stardust holds magical power.
No wonder Xue Musheng, the head teacher, emphasizes all day long: You must keep meditating even when you are bored. No matter how talented a magician is, if he does not meditate diligently, he will become extremely mediocre.
This sentence can basically be understood as: No matter how good your skills are, you are still a scumbag if you don’t have blue!
Forget it, don't think about these things, get some sleep quickly, otherwise you will really die!
…
Nestled in the room and slept until dawn.
Ye Xinxia is also a well-behaved girl. It's almost noon and she doesn't want to wake herself up.
Mo Fan climbed up from the bed, feeling very energetic.
After skillfully entering the meditative state, I checked my stardust and found that most of the stardust had become brighter. I think it would be able to fully return to its usual glory soon.
"By the way, I'm afraid it's not easy for my thunder element to be exposed to outsiders. Although this is a society governed by 'laws', if it is not protected, people will be jealous. For example, in Bo City, the Mu family can cover the sky with one hand. It seems that I still have to practice the fire element. This will make it easier to hide from others." Mo Fan thought about this problem while brushing his teeth.
However, I only have so much energy in one day, how can I keep the thunder-type main wife well fed and the fire-type concubine submissive at the same time?
Mo Fan was able to master the thunder skill in five months precisely because he devoted all his training time to the thunder skill. No matter how charming and charming the fire-type goblin was, Mo Fan was dedicated and single-minded.
The annual magic assessment is about half a year away. If I don't want to expose the power of the thunder system so early, I have to concentrate on practicing the fire system in the next semester and master the basic skills of the fire system.
But doing so would mean that the growth of his Thunder System Stardust would be stagnant for half a year.
If you don't meditate, Stardust won't become stronger for nothing!
…
Mo Fan made some small plans for his next meditation time.
